units.source_text: 源氏晚年出家，栖隐嵯峨院。

en.t: In his later years, Genji took religious vows and lived in seclusion at Saga-in.

units.source_text: 此事前文未曾提及，此处是初见。

en.t: This matter has not been mentioned earlier in the text; this is its first appearance.

units.source_text: 当是第四十一回《云隐》中事。

en.t: It must refer to something from Chapter 41, The Vanishing into the Clouds.
